workDescription: Worked on Power Management System for Roti Proa II, a solar-powered autonomous boat, consisting of the combination of firmware, software, and hardware.
Implemented a **power management system** using **Arduino** and **Python** to monitor and control the power consumption of the boat.
Developed a **web-based dashboard** using **React** and **Node.js** to visualize the power consumption data and provide real-time feedback to the user.
